summary: Batch 32 — Enterprise BI Feed testing complete: OData v4 + Tableau WDC + CSV download. 33/33 backend tests passed, all frontend UI elements verified.
seed_data_creation: Test tokens created via API tests (TEST_BiToken_*, TEST_PowerBI_*, TEST_ToRevoke_*, TEST_Playwright_Token)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 32 Enterprise BI Feed fully tested. All 10 endpoints working: POST /api/bi/tokens (create with hbk_ prefix), GET /api/bi/tokens/{property_id} (list with masked tokens), DELETE /api/bi/tokens/{token_id} (soft revoke), GET /api/bi/odata?token=X (service catalog with 6 entities), GET /api/bi/odata/$metadata?token=X (XML EDM v4), GET /api/bi/odata/{Entity}?token=X (entity collection with $top/$skip/$filter), GET /api/bi/csv/{Entity}?token=X (RFC 4180 CSV), GET /api/bi/tableau-wdc.html (public WDC 2.3 HTML), GET /api/bi/sample-urls/{token_id} (connection examples). Frontend BiFeedPanel has 3 tabs (Token'lar, Bağlanma Talimatları, CSV İndir), token creation with just-created banner, 4 connection cards (Power BI, Excel, Tableau, OData), 6 CSV entity download buttons.

backend: POST /api/bi/tokens - creates token with hbk_<32_hex> format
GET /api/bi/odata?token=X - returns service catalog with 6 entities
GET /api/bi/odata/$metadata?token=X - returns XML EDM v4 with all entity types
All 6 entities accessible (Bookings, Tips, FnbTabs, Inquiries, CleanlinessScores, WorkOrders)
Entity access stamps last_used_at and increments use_count
GET /api/bi/csv/Bookings - returns text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment
GET /api/bi/tableau-wdc.html - contains WDC 2.3 script and all entities
GET /api/bi/sample-urls/{token_id} - returns odata_root, odata_metadata, csv_examples, odata_examples, tableau_wdc, powerbi_instructions, excel_instructions
Full revocation flow: create → verify works → revoke → verify denied
frontend: BiFeedPanel renders with title 'Power BI · Tableau · Excel'
3 tabs: Token'lar (bi-tab-tokens), Bağlanma Talimatları (bi-tab-connect), CSV İndir (bi-tab-csv)
Token form: name input (bi-form-name), days input (bi-form-days), submit (bi-form-submit)
Just-created token banner (bi-just-created) with copy button (bi-copy-fresh-token)
Token rows show: name, status badge (AKTİF/İPTAL EDİLDİ), token_masked, dates, use_count, last_used
4 connection cards: Power BI (bi-connect-powerbi), Excel (bi-connect-excel), Tableau (bi-connect-tableau), OData (bi-connect-odata)
Connection cards have copy buttons and Tableau has external link
6 entity download buttons in grid (bi-csv-grid): Rezervasyonlar, Bahşişler, F&B Tab'lar, MICE Talepleri, Temizlik Skorları, İş Emirleri
Sidebar: BI Feed (Power BI · Tableau) button with ChartBar icon

validation_details.usage_tracking: last_used_at, use_count incremented on entity/csv access
